design_philosophy: A professional and high-end aesthetic conveying trust, quality, and style. The deep blue (azul profundo) grounds the brand in clinical professionalism, while the gold (dorado) elevates the user experience to luxury e-commerce. Generous negative space and crisp photography highlight the eyewear as premium artifacts.

images.description: Luxury optical store interior with sunglasses displayed on shelves. Use with a dark gradient overlay (bg-primary/40) if placing white text.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the floating WhatsApp button using the number 9995106899.
Ensure the hero heading does not use Inter. Use Playfair Display.
Do not use generic blue defaults. The primary blue MUST be the deep navy (#0B1B3D).
Use Phosphor Icons (Thin/Light weight) for all UI icons (cart, user, filter).
Every interactive element (button, select, input, cart icon) must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on its role.
In the Admin panel, use Shadcn Table for managing products, applying the same deep navy/gold high-contrast styling.
Do not use rounded heavy shadows. Follow the 'Crisp/Neumorphism' surface strategy for product cards (1px borders, white bg, subtle hover lift).
